title: bug: under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 on Windows, npm .cmd shims (claude.cmd, codex.cmd) and cmd.exe search the project directory before PATH, so a project-root node.exe still runs
description:
Found by CQ-RF07 (task-f3f364a6), the epic-final adversarial review. It is residual 3 in architect-54e5eb09's comment-1deae51a on that row, and task-64809b19 does not fix it.

Evidence at 28df02f7: moe-agent.ps1 pins node (Find-MoeProtectedFile, MOE_PROTECTED_INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND) and resolves the agent CLI to an absolute path outside the project. But the seat runs with the project as its working directory, and the resolved CLI is typically an npm shim (`claude.cmd`) that runs `node` by bare name when no node.exe sits beside it. cmd.exe, and CreateProcess without NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath, look in the current directory before PATH. A repository that ships `node.exe` at its root therefore runs it inside the protected seat, whatever PATH order the wrapper sets.

Fix direction: under the marker, set NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 in the environment the wrapper gives the CLI (cmd.exe and CreateProcess both honour it), or run a resolved .cmd CLI through the pinned node directly. Pin the behaviour with a ps1 row that plants <project>\node.exe and asserts it never runs.
definitionOfDone: Under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 on Windows, a node.exe (or other bare-named helper) planted at the project root never runs through the agent CLI's shim or any cmd.exe child of the seat; a postflight or node --test row on Windows node.exe proves it with a planted file.
Legacy seats are unchanged, and the sh/ps1 parity check passes.
The protected-agent-command and launcher suites exit 0 on Linux and through Windows node.exe.
reopenReason: Human "move from backlog": CQ-RF07 epic-final review residual (Windows .cmd shim project-dir search under protected runtime).

comments.content:
Planner input from CQ-RF07 (task-f3f364a6), epic-final review, finding 6 (LOW, Windows ps1, same class as this row).

`Find-MoeProtectedFile` (scripts/moe-agent.ps1 ~499-523) skips in-project PATH entries by comparing `Get-MoeRealPath` strings (`$real.Equals($project)` or the `"$real$sep".StartsWith("$project$sep")` check at ~518). It compares spellings, not file identity, so the same folder reached through an 8.3 short name, a `subst` drive or a `\\?\`/UNC spelling slips past the containment check, and a node.exe there would be pinned. The JetBrains side matches by file identity (task-9a1da6f6).

This needs the user's own PATH to carry such an alias of the project, which is why it is LOW. Fold an identity compare (volume serial plus file index, as the plugin does), or an explicit refusal of 8.3/subst/UNC entries, into this row's Windows fix, with a postflight.ps1 row.
